evan: Putting notes from today's RFC follow-up: we need concise heuristics for runtime to pick between FP8/INT8/4bit and when to trigger fallback. Punting heavy sampling to offline, but runtime needs lightweight gating.
maya: Agree. Proposed: runtime exposes `precision_hint` (enum) + `quality_budget` (0-1). QC then decides. If quality_budget < 0.2 prefer 4-bit, else FP8/INT8. Thoughts?
jun: Quality_budget in request sounds good but we can't trust customer-provided values. Need server-side guardrails and per-customer calibrations.
rachel: Telemetry point: we need sample selection strategy for long-tail prompts. Can we tag requests with `sampling_eligibility:true` and sample 1% or 1/100 per customer? Also store prompt fingerprint + degscore.
evan: Yes. Server-side calibs: maintain 'anchor' examples per customer. Runtime does quick similarity check (LSH) to anchors -> apply calibrated thresholds. If not similar -> default conservative.
ops-bot: canary-deploy: quant-runtime-v1.4 rolled to 10% traffic in eu-west-1 :rocket:
maya: Quick API decomposition idea: runtime-level `precision_policy` (global) + endpoint-level overrides + per-request hints. Keep negotiation order: per-request hint -> endpoint override -> global policy. That keeps surface minimal.
jun: Concern: adding per-customer anchors increases state. Let's define eviction TTL and versioning. Proposal: anchor set per customer max 200 anchors, LRU TTL 30d, plus a version hash in checkout.
rachel: For telemetry sampling code example: ```json
{"sampling_rate":0.01,"eligibility_filter":"long_tail||low_confidence"}
``` also include `deg_score`, `latency_ms`, `precision_used` fields.
evan: Fallback hysteresis: don't flip precision on single sample. Use moving average over 100 requests or min 10s window. Also require quality regression > X to trigger rollback.
maya: Ops note: must emit telemetry tags for canary traffic so we can separate signals. Also add synthetic anchor test every deploy to ensure we don't regress.
jun: Action items: (1) spec runtime API fields + negotiation priority (maya), (2) implement LSH anchor check proto (jun), (3) add telemetry sampling + schemas (rachel), (4) roll canary with tags and synthetic probes (ops).
evan: I'll open RFC follow-up PR with the proposed JSON schema and a draft of the sample code. Assigning owners as above. :thumbsup:
